title: Fourier-cosine Tensor Trains for Density Recovery and Expectation Calculation
summary: The Fourier-cosine (COS) method of Fang and Oosterlee (2008) recovers densities and computes expectations semi-analytically from characteristic functions (ch.f.s). In higher dimensions, both expansion synthesis and COS coefficient-tensor construction scale exponentially with dimension. We address this curse of dimensionality with two tensor-train (TT) methods. A straightforward TT decomposition of the COS coefficient tensor gives COS-TT, which removes the exponential cost of online synthesis but not of offline decomposition.
